entry.title: Bobat
entry.content: A collaborative paper I worked on with the Sage lab, Transcriptional networks underlying tumour plasticity in small-cell lung cancer is officially preprinted! Take a look for more info about the second generation of BooleaBayes, BoBa-T, which uses single cell ATAC-seq and RNA-seq to build, simulate, and perturb transcription factor networks.
